run_gen_static_metadata: run the python script to generate gRPC static metadata C header and source files
run_mangle: run the mangle function to convert metadata names into valid C identifier strings
run_perfect_hash: run the perfect_hash function to generate a perfect hash table for metadata element lookup
run_esc_dict: run the esc_dict function to escape bytes into a C-style hex string for the HPACK dictionary
run_fake_hash: run the fake_hash function to generate an 8-character MD5 hex digest for a metadata string
